result.edit: The failure occurs in cycle 6 when checking sequence 011100. The test expects outputs 10 (match=1, not_match=0) but gets 01 (match=0, not_match=1). The issue is that after reaching sf6 (failure state), the state machine incorrectly transitions back to s1/sf1 instead of resetting to idle. This causes incorrect behavior in subsequent groups. Changing the sf6 transition to go to idle ensures proper group separation and matches the specification's requirement that groups are non-overlapping 6-bit sequences.
